asuka_lv1_director_surgeon_preop.title: The Director Is Also a Surgeon · Scrub Sink
asuka_lv1_director_surgeon_preop.teaser: At the fourth-floor scrub sink, Asuka is already scrubbing in ahead of you as first assistant.
asuka_lv1_director_surgeon_preop.gallery_caption: Before surgery at the scrub sink, Asuka greets Sakaguchi with soapy forearms raised in sterile posture.
asuka_lv1_director_surgeon_preop.final_choice: Push open the OR door together with Asuka

nodes.al1a_001: Ten minutes remain before the scheduled skin incision. Having finished verifying the signed preoperative consent form in hand, Takashi Sakaguchi had barely rounded the corner into the fourth-floor scrub area when he heard water already rushing from the innermost sensor faucet.
nodes.al1a_002: Asuka Shiromiya was already standing before the sink. The long hair she usually wore loose over her shoulders was neatly tucked all the way into her surgical cap, revealing a clean, smooth forehead and a pair of bright, spirited eyes. Catching sight of Sakaguchi approaching, she curved her eyes into a warm smile and gave a little wave of her elbow with forearms covered in fine lather by way of greeting.
nodes.al1a_003: “Right on time, Dr. Sakaguchi. The patient was just brought into the operating room for the safety check, and the instrument count at the back table went smoothly too.”
nodes.al1a_004: Sakaguchi stepped up to the adjacent sink, pressed the foot pedal, dispensed surgical scrub soap, and couldn't help chuckling at the young hospital director moving through the routine with practiced ease beside him.
nodes.al1a_005: “Even though I'm the one who checked your name today to ask for a hand... counting today, how is it that every time I invite you to scrub in as assistant, you not only say yes faster than anyone else, you beat me—the lead surgeon—to the scrub sink?”
nodes.al1a_006: “Because when I receive an official request from the lead surgeon, I naturally have to bring the professional attitude of a proper first assistant.”
nodes.al1a_007: “You say that... but Director, don't you have financial statements and staffing approvals piled on your desk to deal with today?”
nodes.al1a_008: “Hehe, underestimating me, aren't you? Every urgent file that needed my signature was approved and sent back to Administration before eight o'clock first thing this morning, and for this block right now, my calendar proudly reads ‘Clinical Duty’ in big bold letters.”
nodes.al1a_009: Warm water rinsed the lather cleanly from between her fingers and down her forearms. Holding her hands raised above her elbows in textbook sterile posture, Asuka glanced sideways toward Sakaguchi, an unmistakable lightness sparkling in the bright eyes above her mask.
nodes.al1a_010: “Besides, when my mother handed Hoshimi over to me, there was never any rule saying that becoming director meant locking myself behind a desk stamping papers every single day. I earned my surgical license fair and square, you know—compared to staring blankly at a dry stack of consumables budget sheets, standing right here listening to running water and patient monitors is a hundred times more invigorating.”
nodes.al1a_011: “Looks like our hospital director genuinely loves being in the operating room.”
nodes.al1a_012: “Of course I do! Clean, orderly, everyone focused together on doing one thing right—where in the entire hospital could you find a more reassuring place than the OR? Come on, Lead Surgeon Sakaguchi, let's not keep the nurses and the patient waiting inside—I'm in your care as first assistant today!”

asuka_lv1_director_surgeon_postop.title: The Director Is Also a Surgeon
asuka_lv1_director_surgeon_postop.teaser: Stepping out into the OR buffer zone after surgery, Asuka shares her candid love for clinical work.
asuka_lv1_director_surgeon_postop.gallery_caption: In the OR doffing area after operating together, Asuka takes off her surgical cap and asks Sakaguchi to drop the formal title in private.
asuka_lv1_director_surgeon_postop.final_choice: See Asuka off as she heads to change

nodes.al1b_001: As the automatic doors of the operating room slid softly shut behind them, the taut focus that had held through the final closing stitch eased away as well.
nodes.al1b_002: Sakaguchi tossed his peeled-off latex gloves into the medical disposal bin, untied the mask strings behind his head, and glanced over at Asuka Shiromiya beside him as she deftly folded her dark-green sterile surgical gown inside out to slip it into the linen recovery bag.
nodes.al1b_003: Even after holding retractors steady beneath the shadowless lamp for nearly an hour, only the faintest sheen of sweat lingered at her temples; far from looking tired, she seemed even more radiant than when he had crossed paths with her in the administrative hallway earlier in the morning.
nodes.al1b_004: “The exposure you gave me today was remarkably comfortable—saved me a lot of effort. Still, I have to wonder: you're already the director running the entire hospital, and nobody would fault you if you stayed away from clinical duty altogether, so why do you still love scrubbing in yourself so much?”
nodes.al1b_005: Asuka tucked the neatly folded gown into the recovery bag, dusted her hands lightly together, turned to meet Sakaguchi's gaze, and curved her lips into a matter-of-fact smile.
nodes.al1b_006: “Because I simply love it, plain and simple.”
nodes.al1b_007: “Here I thought you'd take the opportunity to give me a directorial speech about how ‘staying close to the clinical frontline optimizes hospital management decisions.’”
nodes.al1b_008: “Oh, if I were giving an annual report at the Municipal Medical Association, I'd definitely write it like that in my script—understanding the frontline really is important, after all. But in front of a partner I just stepped off the table with, why dress up what I like to sound so grand? I just genuinely love the air in the operating room, and watching an operation get carried out cleanly from start to finish.”
nodes.al1b_009: Saying that, Asuka glanced down at the standard-issue sterile hospital gown she had just placed into the linen bag; her delicate brows knit ever so slightly as she raised her fingers to measure off half an inch at the side of her shoulder and lower back.
nodes.al1b_010: “Though there is one thing I've been meaning to mention... Dr. Sakaguchi, when you raised your hands to tie knots earlier, didn't you feel the armholes on this batch of standard surgical gowns are cut just a touch too low? And the second back tie sits a full inch below the ideal proportion too—once it's cinched, the whole shoulder-and-back line hangs loose instead of looking crisp.”
nodes.al1b_011: Sakaguchi blinked for two seconds and looked down at the linen recovery bag holding the exact same gown he had worn for hours without paying the slightest attention to its cut.
nodes.al1b_012: “...Isn't a sterile gown fine so long as it's fluid-resistant, low-lint, and fits well enough? While you were holding retractors at the table just now, you actually had the spare attention to critique shoulder seams and tie proportions?”
nodes.al1b_013: “What do you mean, ‘actually’?! A surgeon wears that gown for at least an hour or two every time they scrub in—whether the cut fits properly, whether raising your arms feels smooth, and whether the person wearing it looks sharp, professional, and good in it are all completely legitimate matters of craft, thank you very much!”
nodes.al1b_014: Tilting her chin up slightly, she defended her aesthetic standards in complete earnest, seeing nothing remotely unusual about studying the tailoring of sterile surgical wear.
nodes.al1b_015: “All right, all right—chalk it up to me being a layman, Director.”
nodes.al1b_016: At those final words, Asuka—just raising her hand to slip off her surgical cap—paused mid-motion. Tilting her head to study Sakaguchi for a moment, she softened her voice a touch, carrying a young person's candidness mingled with a trace of shy awkwardness.
nodes.al1b_018: “Hm? Another case on the schedule you wanted to go over?”
nodes.al1b_019: “It's not about the schedule. It's just... we've stood at the operating table together and worked in sync this well by now, so when we're just chatting in private, could you maybe stop calling me ‘Director’ every other sentence?”
nodes.al1b_021: “Mm. At an all-staff assembly or when visitors from another hospital are around, ‘Director’ can't be helped, of course—but hearing someone I know well call me that even when we're just passing in the corridor or scrubbing our hands always makes me feel like you're addressing an elder, and I still haven't quite gotten used to it.”
nodes.al1b_022: Slipping off her surgical cap, she shook out her soft long hair and looked up at Sakaguchi with bright, open eyes:
nodes.al1b_023: “When nobody else is around on official business, you're welcome to call me ‘Shiromiya-kun’ the way peers and seniors in a medical department do—or just call me ‘Asuka’ outright.”
nodes.al1b_024: Sakaguchi blinked slightly, then let out a quiet laugh and nodded.
nodes.al1b_025: “Got it. In private I'll try to switch to ‘Asuka’ or ‘Shiromiya-kun’—though since everyone around the department calls you ‘Director’ out of habit, don't hold it against me if it slips out again one of these days.”
nodes.al1b_026: “Pfft, why would I hold a grudge over that? It's not like I'm issuing you an administrative directive! Whatever rolls off the tongue naturally is fine, and calling me Director on the job is totally fine too!”
nodes.al1b_027: Tossing the used surgical cap into the disposal bin, she took two light steps backward toward the women's changing room and turned to wave at Sakaguchi with a clean, radiant smile.
nodes.al1b_028: “I'm going to change back into my white coat and finish approving the rest of my paperwork. Next time you have a suitable operation that needs a first assistant, remember to call on me—see you later, Sakaguchi-kun!”
